== Notes ==
* This can be a very useful tool for taking down a powerful, single target when used with allies (e.g. [[minion]]s) that deal physical damage.
* Damage from this skill is dealt as a separate [[packet]] from the damage which triggers it.
{{Bug|Causes skills such as [[Xinrae's Weapon]] and [[Vengeful Weapon]] to trigger twice.}}
